categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies top-level CMakeLists.txt and ci/test/ scripts to integrate functional test discovery into CTest and run it in native macOS CI.
categories.rationale: Enables opt-in CTest orchestration for functional tests across CMake builds and CI. This provides developer ergonomics and standard IDE integration without fixing an active build breakage.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Labeled Tests; updates test_runner.py with an inventory manifest generator and a `--ctest-direct` execution mode.
categories.rationale: Improves test runner infrastructure by allowing individual functional tests to be queried and executed through standard CTest flags like `-R` and `--rerun-failed`. The change expands framework capabilities but does not affect test signal or test flakiness.
